records.scope: Closed orientable3manifolds with isomorphic groups differ only by orientations of prime factors and lens-space ambiguity. A closed orientable prime irreducible infinite-group graph-manifold model therefore determines any closed orientable manifold with its group up to homeomorphism and orientation; no boundary-manifold or finite lens-group rigidity shortcut.

records.audit: Published introduction and all relevant hypotheses re-read, including the graph-manifold definition as prime, and explicit treatment of both arborescent and non-arborescent branches. Cor1.3 assumes bridge exactly4; it does not by itself turn an upper4 into equality. Theorem1.2 plus the known meridional ranks1/2 equivalences gives MRC throughout this cover class with bridge at most4. Full rank3 inversion and branch-involution classification proof not independently audited.
records.scope: Graph-manifold double branched cover and meridional rank3 imply bridge3; exact bridge4 in that class gives meridional rank4. Hence this existing theorem covers the sixteen programme cases once actual-cover graph-manifold membership is proved by closed rigidity. This is distinct from the2017 theorem about graph-manifold knot exteriors. Prime nontrivial-JSJ knot exteriors have meridional rank at least4.
